name: Haiku deep value
strategy: Momentum mean-reversion via sector rotation: short unsustainable momentum extremes (SOXL, TQQQ after 6-12 month runs), rotate into steady outperformers (energy, small-cap value, financials), amplify capitulation signals via crypto perps, enforce daily volatility stop discipline.
novelty: Shifts from value-screening fundamentals (R1) and core broad-market value holdings (R2) to systematic momentum mean-reversion. Directly exploits regime shift: shorts momentum extremes (SOXL 3x short after +506% run, TQQQ short after tech drawdown) while rotating into steadier sectors, capturing alpha from volatility regime change rather than security selection. Uses position-level daily stops for tactical discipline rather than passive core positions.

positions.thesis: Russell 2000 Value +29.5% (12m), +1.4% (1m) shows stability; captures sector rotation away from mega-cap tech outperformance.
Energy +34.1% (12m), +2.4% (1m) momentum; different correlation to tech sector; steady performer in rotation.
Financials +6.0% (1m) recent strength signals rate-environment recovery; +11.2% (12m) baseline.
Emerging markets -6.0% (1m) dip after +37.3% (12m) run; oversold mean-reversion opportunity.
Low-volatility defensive hedge if momentum mean-reversion thesis doesn't fully materialize; provides downside cushion.
Regional banks +26.5% (12m), +5.5% (1m); specialized financial exposure with rate sensitivity, different beta than XLF.
Bitcoin -46% (12m) capitulation crushed but stabilizing +5.2% (1m); 3x leverage captures capitulation recovery wave; crypto regime shift signal.
3x semiconductor +506.8% (12m) run unsustainable; -39.2% (1m) reversal underway; shorting extreme captures mean-reversion acceleration.
3x Nasdaq -11.8% (1m) after massive 12m run; mega-cap tech unwind as attention rotates to steady sectors; short leverage amplifies positioning.

outlook: Tech's 12-month momentum (+40% to +506% in leveraged products) is unsustainable and reversing (-5% to -39% recent). Expect continued sector rotation into steady outperformers (energy, small-cap value, financials) over the 5-month horizon. Crypto capitulation signals early stabilization; leverage captures recovery upside. Daily stop discipline limits whipsaw losses if momentum persists despite being extended. Key risk: if tech sharply reverses course, shorts face mark-to-market pressure (mitigated by stops); if rotation stalls, long positions underperform broad market. Cash buffer (48%) provides flexibility to adapt as mean-reversion thesis plays out.
